description: You are a healthcare facilities manager for Lakewood Family Medicine, a newly established primary care clinic. The building shell (walls and floor plan) has already been drafted in Sweet Home 3D and is open on screen. Your task is to furnish and lay out the entire clinic interior so it is ready for a construction contractor review. The clinic must include: (1) a patient waiting area with seating capacity for at least 20 people and a reception/check-in counter; (2) at least two fully equipped examination rooms, each containing an exam table or bed, a chair for the physician, and a chair for the patient; (3) a nurse or staff workstation with a desk; (4) a restroom accessible from the waiting area. Source all furniture from Sweet Home 3D's built-in catalog. When your layout is complete, save the file (the file is already open — use File > Save or Ctrl+S).
